# dsh-plugin-agent-optimizer
English | 中文
High-performance, non-invasive runtime policy, PTC-backed composite batch tooling, standalone refine
d system prompt engine (~80% token savings), and objective A/B turn telemetry plugin for the officia
l DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop`).
## Highlights in v1.5.0
- **RFC 2119 Restrictive Modal Capitalization & Salience**: Convergence reminders enforce `NEVER omi
t verification.` to block premature completion under step pressure. Restrictive boundaries (`ONLY`,
`NEVER`, `STRICTLY`) are capitalized consistently across guidance, templates, and runtime intercept

reasons.
- **Precision Tool Alignment with Official DSH Contracts**: `edit_batch` schema and paramet
er descriptions strictly mirror official `edit` tool semantics (`Provide file_path before old_string
and new_string in the arguments`). Decoupled verbs (`produce deliverables`) prevent homonym collisi

ons with native tools.
- **Refined Command Chaining Policy**: Relaxed `CHAINED_NETWORK_COMMAND` to s
afely permit chained non-blocking local commands like `git push` while strictly preventing Windows h

anging on credentials and publish (`npm publish`).
- **Standalone `SYSTEM.md` Engine & ~80% Token Re
duction (`placement: "replace-all"`)**: Completely prunes verbose official prompt sections, allowing
a concise, standalone `~/.dsh/SYSTEM.md` (~380 tokens) to govern as the single authority. Saves ~1.
one `~/.dsh/SYSTEM.md` (~380 tokens) to govern as the single authority. Saves ~1.6K tokens per turn.
## Core Features & Architecture
### 1. Refined System Prompt & File-Driven Hot-Reload (`customPrompt`)

- **Standalone Mode (`placement: "replace-all"`)**:
Hooks into the DSH `system-prompt/assemble` wate
rfall to strip all official verbose sections (`harness:*`, `deployment:*`, `tool:*`, `deliverable:*`
, `web:*`), preserving convergence guidance companion sections while presenting your refined `SYSTEM

.md` as the standalone authority (~82% reduction from ~2,000 to ~380 tokens).
- **Dual-Layer Markdow

n Convention**:
Automatically discovers global `~/.dsh/SYSTEM.md` (or `$DSH_HOME/SYSTEM.md`) and pro
ject workspace `.dsh/SYSTEM.md` (or `SYSTEM.md`), cleanly separating developer system defaults from

repo-specific instructions.
- **Millisecond Hot-Reload**:
Uses debounced `fs.watch` to detect prompt

file edits and applies them reactively on the very next turn without restarting the DSH process.
-

**Flexible Cascading Strategies**:
Supports `concat` (cascading global and workspace prompts, defaul

t) and `workspace-override` (repo prompt completely replaces global prompt).
- **Built-in Prompt Lin

ter & Auto-Fixer**:
Provides `lintPrompt` / `fixPrompt` / `lintPromptFile` APIs with **preset-aware
dynamic tool validation**. Eliminates subjective tool assumptions by verifying tool directives direc
tly against active plugins: flags redundant defensive clauses for unloaded tools or conflicts with a
ctively loaded tools, checks weak modals (`bias toward` -> `Prioritize`), unclosed backticks, and en
forces RFC 2119 uppercase constraints with actionable health scoring (0-100).

| Dimension | Official Default System Prompt | Optimized with This Plugin | Savings |
| :--- | :---

| :--- | :--- |
| **Token Usage** | ~2,000 tokens / turn | **~380 tokens / turn** | **~82% token red

uction** |
| **Long Multi-Turn Sessions** | ~100K redundant tokens across 50 turns | Clean, focused,

high-density context | **Mitigates context drift & forgetting** |
| **Config Updates** | Requires r
estart or reload | Instant hot-reload on file save | **Immediate feedback** |
### 2. PTC Native Composite Batch Tooling (`compositeTools`)

- **`read_batch`**:
Concurrently inspects up to 10 targeted file snippets in a single turn. Ideal fo

r broad multi-file investigation and dependency tracing.
- **`edit_batch`**:
Sequentially applies up
to 10 targeted literal text replacements across single or multiple files in one round trip. Tolerat

es partial failures without losing preceding valid edits.
- **Inherited Security & Sandboxing**:
Eve
ry sub-action is dispatched through the official `ToolExecutionPipeline` (`tool/ptc-dispatch-start`
/ `tool/ptc-dispatch`), preserving file policy locks, mutation guards, and audit hooks.
### 3. Defensive Runtime Policy & Self-Healing Recovery

- **No-Progress Circuit Breaker (`NO_PROGRESS`)**:
Computes deterministic tool invocation fingerprin
ts. If an identical failing tool call repeats up to `noProgressLimit` (default `2`), the plugin bloc

ks execution at `tools/pre-execute`, forcing the agent to adapt its diagnostic approach.
- **Windows

Oversized Shell Command Interception (`EMBEDDED_SHELL_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`)**:
Automatically blocks c
ommands exceeding `4096` bytes or inline scripts (`node -e`, `python -c`, `pwsh -Command`) exceeding

`512` bytes, steering the model to write deliverables to disk first.
- **Windows Chained Network Co

mmand Guard (`CHAINED_NETWORK_COMMAND`)**:
Intercepts compound shell commands that chain network/cre
dential-bound operations (`npm publish`) with local operations during `tools/pre-execute`. Enforces
clean two-tier execution: local operations chained via `&&` for zero-RTT speed, and network operatio

ns isolated standalone to eliminate Windows process handle hanging and 120s timeouts.
- **Full Overw

rite Protection & Single-Shot Recovery (`failureRecovery`)**:
Prevents accidental destructive `write
` overwrites on existing large files when `edit` is available. Automatically registers `retry_failed
_write` when a large write (8KB–1MB) is rejected due to an unpaired justification, avoiding costly r
a large write (8KB–1MB) is rejected due to an unpaired justification, avoiding costly regeneration.
### 4. Lightweight Convergence & Objective A/B Telemetry

- **Micro-Directive Convergence (`convergence`)**:
Appends soft guidance notices when steps approach
budget intervals (default `stepInterval: 8`, max `4` per turn). Features **error-aware suppression*

*: automatically silences notices during debugging so trouble resolution remains uninterrupted.
- **

Objective A/B Telemetry (`telemetry`)**:
Collects granular operational metrics including model reque
sts, tool calls, composite parallelism ratio (`parallelismRatio`), time-to-first-token (TTFT), token
consumption, and prefix cache stability (`prefixChanges`).
